elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies "Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason."

elements.element: HDI must provide transition assistance to the Company.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) requires HDI, at the Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance, including Site migration and hosting-transfer cooperation.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) provides assistance "for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date."

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at HDI's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) expressly states that the assistance is provided "at HDI's then-current rates."

elements.element: HDI must return all Company Data in its possession or control to the Company.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires delivery to the Company of all Content, customer and user information, order data, and other Company data in HDI's possession or control.

elements.element: Company Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires delivery within thirty days of the Termination Date. The shown termination mechanics define that date as the date the Agreement terminates.

elements.element: Company Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires a "commonly used, machine-readable format," which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: HDI must delete the returned Company Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(c) requires HDI to "thereafter delete all such Content and data from its systems."

elements.element: HDI must certify deletion of the Company Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(c) requires HDI to certify the deletion to the Company in writing.

elements.element: The transition-assistance and data-export obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 expressly applies upon expiration or termination for any reason.

elements.element: HDI must provide transition assistance for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The assistance is available for up to six months at the Company's request, encompassing a requested 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: HDI must export Company Data to the Company.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires HDI to deliver the specified Company data to the Company in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: The Company Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires delivery within thirty days of the Termination Date.

result.reason: The redline satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It is not strictly minimal because it additionally mandates delivery of Site and URL access credentials, an independent deliverable not required by either position. Unrelated termination and payment terms remain unchanged. Drafting is generally clear, but deadlines and the assistance period are measured from the defined "Termination Date" even though Section 4.3 also invokes "expiration"; if an expiration can occur without a Termination Date, timing would be ambiguous.
